facts.fact: The Bank of Algeria published instruction no. 06-2025 of 17 August 2025 setting the organisation and operating rules of payment service providers, completing regulation no. 25-02 of 14 April 2025 on their authorisation and licensing (Algérie Éco, 19 August 2025).
facts.system: Instruction n° 06-2025 and Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers
